html:
Hello

Here is my first image taken with the Takahashi EM-200 Temma II mount

It is the galaxy Messier 51 and its companion NGC 5195 just to the north. Located in the constellation Canes Venatici, Messier 51, also called the Whirlpool Galaxy, is about 37 million light-years away.




Technical details
Date:  2009/04/20+23 +25
Optical train = Meade SCT 10" f6.3 - MPCC - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon 40 unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSyky 6 software
Site: At home
83 exposures of 5 min for 415 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop + carboni + neatImage + gradiant Xterminator
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software


Here is the first photo of Messier 51 that I took in March 2008
